module.name: Social Post
module.notes: Social Post header phase with two symmetric five-slot rows.

intent.responsibility: Own the Social Post header as two fixed five-slot rows.
intent.visualBoundary: Render a Surface containing two intrinsic-height rows and Theme-owned system chrome.
intent.runtimeBehavior: The Variant selects each slot kind and child Variant; Runtime owns only actor, label and sublabel values.
intent.forwarding: No child Runtime contract is exposed or forwarded.
intent.temporalOwnership: The Screen owns header presence while child Components retain their local behavior.
intent.productionContext: Resolve only through the exact Production Screen to Shot owner Actor to Theme and Device context.

metadata.note: Social Post currently defines only its two-row header phase.
